line.aria-label: date: Sep 27, 2024; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2024-09-27T18:42:32Z; Historical label: EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion; Normalization rationale: Commit 1d4ce546 (PR #8911) restructured EIP-7607 into Scheduled/Considered/Proposed sections (definitions per EIP-7723) and listed EIP-7594 under 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion'. The PR states it formalizes the Pectra scope changes agreed at ACDE#197 (2024-09-26, pm issue #1153), which moved PeerDAS out of Pectra into Fusaka. The ACDE#197 minutes record Tim Beiko's summary that 'the only two things included in Osaka would be EOF and DAS for now'. 'Scheduled for Inclusion' maps directly to scheduled_for_inclusion.; Source: Add EIP: Hardfork Meta - Amsterdam; Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/1d4ce5462677c5af8852cae6105ebf4c941f363b/EIPS/eip-7607.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/1d4ce5462677c5af8852cae6105ebf4c941f363b/EIPS/eip-7607.md

date: Feb 04, 2026; event_kind: included; Normalized state: Included; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2026-02-04T22:29:12Z; Historical label: Included EIPs / Core EIPs; Normalization rationale: Commit 3b1edfd6 moved EIP-7607 to Final after the Fusaka mainnet activation and retitled the 'EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion' section to 'Included EIPs', where this EIP is listed at the pinned master commit. Mainnet activation occurred at epoch 411392 / timestamp 1764798551 (2025-12-03T21:49:11Z) per the Activation table in the pinned document (mainnet row added in commit 45e74bea on 2025-11-06 reflecting ACDC#168, 2025-10-30). occurred_at is the UTC committer date of the repository event; the network activation date is as stated here.; Source: Update EIP-7607: Move to Final (#11237); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/3b1edfd68cdfa6710510f52dbf1f6035b53e085b/EIPS/eip-7607.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/3b1edfd68cdfa6710510f52dbf1f6035b53e085b/EIPS/eip-7607.md

date: Sep 27, 2024; Assessment marker: Proposal anchor; Date / time (UTC): 2024-09-27T18:42:32Z; Event: EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion; Anchor kind: normalized_proposal_equivalent; Selection mode: preceding; Offset from anchor: 0.00 days; Selected commit: ; Review status: approved; Rationale: Task 01's occurred_at for event osaka-eip7594-e1 is the UTC committer date of the ethereum/EIPs commit that made the inclusion-state change to EIPS/eip-7607.md (Hardfork Meta - Fulu/Osaka), and that convention is adopted here. Verified directly from the read-only clone at the Task 01 run-wide pin a08f51fec5b2b5da457adb05b8cffb487fb4f7de: `git log -1 --format='%H %cI %aI %s' 1d4ce5462677c5af8852cae6105ebf4c941f363b` returns committer 2024-09-28T02:42:32+08:00 (= 2024-09-27T18:42:32Z), author 2024-09-27T11:42:32-07:00, subject 'Add EIP: Hardfork Meta - Amsterdam' (squash merge of ethereum/EIPs PR #8911, author Tim Beiko). The underlying AllCoreDevs decision identified by Task 01 is AllCoreDevs - Execution ACDE#197, held 2024-09-26 14:00-15:30 UTC (pm-issue-1153, pm-blob-meeting197-pin), which split the Pectra scope and moved PeerDAS into Fusaka; the repository record therefore lags the decision by roughly 1.2 days. effective_at uses the merge/commit time because under the EIP-7723 process the fork-scope state takes effect when the change to the Meta EIP is merged; recorded_at is the same event. Using the ACDE#197 call date instead would move the anchor at most ~1.2 days earlier and would not change either bracketing candidate (nearest revisions are 103 days before and 106 days after the anchor).; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/1d4ce5462677c5af8852cae6105ebf4c941f363b/EIPS/eip-7607.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/1d4ce5462677c5af8852cae6105ebf4c941f363b/EIPS/eip-7607.md

date: Apr 10, 2025; Assessment marker: Fork evaluation cutoff; Date / time (UTC): 2025-04-10; Event: Fusaka scope freeze; Anchor kind: fork_scope; Selection mode: aggregation_cohort; Offset from anchor: not applicable; Selected commit: ; Review status: proposed; Rationale: ACDE 208 announced an April 10 scope freeze after the PFI deadline and client preference collection; ACDE 209 was the scope-freeze call. The first post-call Meta EIP update records the resulting CFI/SFI changes. This EIP is classified as forecastable at cutoff from Task 01 event osaka-eip7594-e1 at 2024-09-27T18:42:32Z.; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1374; Aggregation cohort: Forecastable at cutoff; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1374

date: Jun 17, 2024; Assessment marker: Selected assessment ref; Date / time (UTC): 2024-06-17T16:19:19Z; Event: Selected ref · 4353b530c370; Anchor kind: normalized_proposal_equivalent; Selection mode: preceding; Offset from anchor: -102.10 days; Selected commit: 4353b530c3701b22d7d2b46f940d8b6608d7aa8a; Review status: approved; Rationale: Default preceding rule. The complete Task 01 revision_history.events list (14 events, e01-e14) was re-derived from git with committer times normalized to UTC (`TZ=UTC git log --date=format-local ... -- EIPS/eip-7594.md`); the list and its order match Task 01 exactly. Relative to the anchor 2024-09-27T18:42:32Z the events split as: e01 creation 2024-05-12T08:49:39Z (-11958773 s) and e02 2024-06-17T16:19:19Z (-8821393 s) at or before the anchor; e03 2025-01-12T00:23:21Z (+9178849 s) and all later events after it. The latest at-or-before event is therefore e02, commit 4353b530c3, and it is selected. No post-anchor exception is even eligible: the following candidate is 106.24 days after the anchor, more than fifteen times the seven-day ceiling. The EIP file was untouched between 2024-06-17T16:19:19Z and 2025-01-12T00:23:21Z, so this blob is byte-for-byte the EIP text that stood in the repository at the moment PeerDAS was placed in the Fusaka scope. Resolution verified in the read-only clone: `git ls-tree 4353b530c3 -- EIPS/eip-7594.md` returns '100644 blob 3d9747d143e6886ba45d3b9a4d5f1a3a5f96449f EIPS/eip-7594.md' (path present at that commit); `git rev-parse 4353b530c3:EIPS/eip-7594.md` returns the same blob SHA; `git cat-file blob 4353b530c3:EIPS/eip-7594.md | sha256sum` returns bf2501c16c94716b9d5c1bf1132792a0a39bb1417c89619458c79f8e9280913b (2729 bytes, 52 lines). information_cutoff_at is the verified anchor time because the preceding revision was selected.; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/4353b530c3701b22d7d2b46f940d8b6608d7aa8a/EIPS/eip-7594.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/4353b530c3701b22d7d2b46f940d8b6608d7aa8a/EIPS/eip-7594.md

date: Apr 01, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-04-02T01:36:08+08:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds a new '### Networking' subsection to the Specification defining a replacement for the EIP-4844 blob-transaction pool wrapper used in PooledTransactions responses: rlp([tx_payload_body, wrapper_version, blobs, commitments, cell_proofs]), with wrapper_version = 1, cell_proofs carrying CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB proofs per blob (extension cells included, blobs sent unextended), the indexing rule cell_proofs[i * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB + j], and four MUST validation conditions the receiving node applies (equal counts, exact cell-proof count, versioned-hash match, commitment/blob/cell-proof consistency with batch verification). Also repoints the detailed-specification link from consensus-specs specs/_features/eip7594/das-core.md (commit b4188829) to the specs/fulu/ tree (commit 9d377fd5).; Classification rationale: Introduces a new normative wire data structure and validation rules for blob transactions; the first execution-layer-observable requirement in the document.; Confidence: high; Commit: b447dd78664f3b9df005e0987b40b2e97a6c38f2; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b447dd78664f3b9df005e0987b40b2e97a6c38f2; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b447dd78664f3b9df005e0987b40b2e97a6c38f2

date: Jul 14, 2025; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-07-14T22:14:09+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds the normative sentence 'Additionally, a limit of 6 blobs per transaction is introduced. date: Sep 05, 2025; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-09-05T21:52:36+08:00; Change type: security_assumption; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Large content expansion ahead of Last Call. Frontmatter: category Networking -> Core and author Alex Stokes (@ralexstokes) added. Replaces the 'TBD' Rationale with five subsections (why DAS scales the DA layer and the 1/8 sampling fraction, what peer sampling provides, why the parameters were chosen, why validators have a custody requirement beyond full nodes, column vs row sampling). Adds a Backwards Compatibility statement ('fully backwards compatible with EIP-4844'), replaces the empty Reference Implementation heading with a Test Cases pointer to the consensus and execution spec tests, and replaces 'Needs discussion' in Security Considerations with a data-withholding analysis including the explicit upper bound P(tricking n*epsilon nodes) <= C(n, n*eps) * C(m, m/2 - 1) * 2^(-k*n*eps) and a table of bounds for 10,000 nodes. Wording touch-ups in the abstract and specification (beacon nodes -> nodes, custody phrasing, wrapper_version emphasis, compute_cells / verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch named).; Classification rationale: Adds the document's security argument and its formal withholding bound, and reclassifies the EIP from Networking to Core. Classified security_assumption because the security analysis is the largest normative-relevant addition; no MUST requirement changed. Medium confidence on the change_type because the commit is a mixed rationale/security/metadata update.; Confidence: medium; Commit: ff212a26b1a4886b18fdf82a48ec4533b60e902a; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ff212a26b1a4886b18fdf82a48ec4533b60e902a; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ff212a26b1a4886b18fdf82a48ec4533b60e902a

date: Feb 21, 2025; Assessment marker: Proposal anchor; Date / time (UTC): 2025-02-21T16:21:57Z; Event: Proposed for Inclusion; Anchor kind: explicit_pfi; Selection mode: preceding; Offset from anchor: 0.00 days; Selected commit: ; Review status: approved; Rationale: Task 01's occurred_at for event osaka-eip7642-e1 is the UTC committer date of the ethereum/EIPs commit that edited EIPS/eip-7607.md (Hardfork Meta - Fusaka), and this record adopts that same basis. Verified directly in the read-only clone pinned at a08f51fec5b2b5da457adb05b8cffb487fb4f7de: commit 314aab3afd8d0f1feb379ed663750421dd95243d has committer time 2025-02-22T00:21:57+08:00 == 2025-02-21T16:21:57Z (author time 2025-02-21T11:21:57-05:00 == 2025-02-21T16:21:57Z; the two coincide because EIP-Bot squash-merged), subject 'Update EIP-7607: proposes eth/69 inclusion in Fusaka', author Justin Florentine. The diff is a single one-line addition, '* [EIP-7642](./eip-7642.md): eth/69 - Drop pre-merge fields', inserted into the '### Proposed for Inclusion' section of EIPS/eip-7607.md, confirmed both from the hunk and from the surrounding section headings in the blob at that commit. effective_at and recorded_at are identical because this is a direct Meta EIP merge; PFI is set when the merge lands, per EIP-7723 and the Task 04 contract. No AllCoreDevs decision underlies this event: Task 01 records decision_body as 'EIP champion via ethereum/EIPs pull request (PFI is champion-initiated per EIP-7723)' and only notes that the eth/69 proposal was trailed by Felix Lange / ralexstokes in the ACDE#208 agenda thread, without attributing PFI to that call. The first AllCoreDevs decision Task 01 identifies for this EIP is ACDE#209 (held 2025-04-10, ethereum/pm issue #1414), which produced the later scheduled_for_inclusion event osaka-eip7642-e2 (commit 9d17611c8710, 2025-04-14T22:10:38Z) and is not the proposal anchor. Task 01's archived GitHub metadata for ethereum/EIPs PR #9324 gives merged_at 2025-02-21T16:21:58Z, one second after the committer time; the Git committer time is used as authoritative and the PR-opening time is deliberately not used.; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/314aab3afd8d0f1feb379ed663750421dd95243d/EIPS/eip-7607.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/314aab3afd8d0f1feb379ed663750421dd95243d/EIPS/eip-7607.md

date: Jan 08, 2025; Assessment marker: Selected assessment ref; Date / time (UTC): 2025-01-08T16:54:23Z; Event: Selected ref · 1632462ccf6d; Anchor kind: explicit_pfi; Selection mode: preceding; Offset from anchor: -43.98 days; Selected commit: 1632462ccf6dfb5d27b7e4bd2cacf0ac122ad4b2; Review status: approved; Rationale: Default preceding rule applied: the selected revision is the latest EIPS/eip-7642.md revision at or before the verified PFI anchor, i.e. the EIP text as it actually stood when the champion placed it in the Fusaka Meta EIP's 'Proposed for Inclusion' section on 2025-02-21T16:21:57Z. No post-anchor exception is available or defensible: the following candidate is 48 days after the anchor, breaching the seven-calendar-day ceiling outright, and it is a substantive rewrite that redefines the wire-protocol messages rather than a completion or correction of the proposal as submitted. The ref was resolved and existence- checked directly in the pinned read-only clone: 'git ls-tree 1632462ccf6dfb5d27b7e4bd2cacf0ac122ad4b2 -- EIPS/eip-7642.md' returns '100644 blob 2a8835e5d926895fc0e0b77675bd4bcf846abb16 EIPS/eip-7642.md', 'git rev-parse <commit>:EIPS/eip-7642.md' gives the same blob SHA, and 'git cat-file blob <commit>:EIPS/eip-7642.md | sha256sum' gives the recorded content SHA-256. At this ref the EIP is titled 'eth/69 - Drop pre-merge fields', has status Stagnant and requires 5793, and specifies only the removal of td from Status (0x00) and of the bloom field from receipts - the NewBlock/NewBlockHashes removals having been dropped in eip7642-e02, and the history- expiry block-range handshake and BlockRangeUpdate message not yet existing. information_cutoff_at is the verified proposal anchor time because the preceding revision was selected, so a later reconstruction task may read this older unchanged text with the context available at PFI but not with later development history.; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/1632462ccf6dfb5d27b7e4bd2cacf0ac122ad4b2/EIPS/eip-7642.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/1632462ccf6dfb5d27b7e4bd2cacf0ac122ad4b2/EIPS/eip-7642.md

date: Apr 11, 2025; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-04-11T09:12:36+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: 'Move to Draft' (ethereum/EIPs#9237, opened 2025-01-13 by Felix Lange and merged 2025-04-11) rewrites the EIP. Title becomes 'eth/69 - history expiry and simpler receipts' and status returns Stagnant -> Draft; Ahmad Bitar is added as an author; the Status (0x00) message gains earliestBlock, latestBlock and latestBlockHash and moves the block hash to the end; a new BlockRangeUpdate (0x11) message is specified with a send-at-most-once-per- epoch rule; the eth/69 receipt encoding becomes the flat list "[tx-type, post-state-or-status, cumulative-gas, logs]" instead of the legacy or typed forms; new Motivation and Rationale sections cover history expiry, and EIP-7542 is cited as an earlier withdrawn proposal of the same idea.; Classification rationale: Adds a new protocol message and redefines two existing message encodings, changing what eth/69 requires of every client implementation and of the test suite.; Confidence: high; Commit: 5d131c12a82e1482877a073ad263117259c729b6; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5d131c12a82e1482877a073ad263117259c729b6; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5d131c12a82e1482877a073ad263117259c729b6

date: Jan 23, 2025; Assessment marker: Proposal anchor; Date / time (UTC): 2025-01-23T23:05:03Z; Event: Proposed for Inclusion; Anchor kind: explicit_pfi; Selection mode: preceding; Offset from anchor: 0.00 days; Selected commit: ; Review status: approved; Rationale: Task 01 event osaka-eip7823-e1 dates PFI to the UTC committer date of the ethereum/EIPs commit that edited EIPS/eip-7607.md (the Fusaka Meta EIP) to add EIP-7823 to its 'Proposed for Inclusion' section: commit a2ed82327dfeabc41f9b9d2bb884e1d7970b7b9d, committer time 2025-01-24T07:05:03+08:00 as recorded in Git, i.e. 2025-01-23T23:05:03Z, author time 2025-01-24T00:05:03+01:00. This is the run-wide Task 01 dating convention for osaka inclusion-state events (see outputs/forks/osaka.yaml unresolved_questions). Under the EIP-7723 process PFI is champion-initiated, and Task 01 records the decision body for this event as 'EIP champion via ethereum/EIPs pull request' (PR #9251, opened by EIP author Alex Beregszaszi); Task 01 identifies NO underlying AllCoreDevs decision for this PFI event, so none is named here. The AllCoreDevs decisions Task 01 does identify for EIP-7823 belong to later states and are not the anchor: ACDE#209 on 2025-04-10 (CFI, event osaka-eip7823-e2) and ACDT#36 on 2025-05-12 (SFI, event osaka-eip7823-e3). effective_at and recorded_at coincide because PFI was set by the merge of the Meta EIP change itself; the PR opening time was not used.; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/a2ed82327dfeabc41f9b9d2bb884e1d7970b7b9d/EIPS/eip-7607.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/a2ed82327dfeabc41f9b9d2bb884e1d7970b7b9d/EIPS/eip-7607.md

Task 01's complete revision_history.events list for EIPS/eip-7823.md contains ten file-changing commits (creation eip7823-e00 plus revisions eip7823-e01..e09); the same ten commits and no others are returned by 'git log --follow -- EIPS/eip-7823.md' at the pin, so the bracketing is mechanically complete. Exactly one of them, the creation commit b16c0553 at 2024-11-26T17:33:25Z, is at or before the anchor 2025-01-23T23:05:03Z, and it is therefore the preceding candidate; the next commit, 3502800f at 2025-01-27T18:37:06Z, is the following candidate. The creation blob is the exact file content that was in the repository when EIP-7823 was placed in the Fusaka Meta EIP's 'Proposed for Inclusion' section, and its normative Specification is byte-identical in substance to the following revision (the 8192-bit / 1024-byte bound and the all-gas-consuming error behaviour are unchanged), so nothing normative is lost by the default choice. date: Feb 21, 2025; Assessment marker: Proposal anchor; Date / time (UTC): 2025-02-21T01:11:23Z; Event: Proposed for Inclusion; Anchor kind: explicit_pfi; Selection mode: preceding; Offset from anchor: 0.00 days; Selected commit: ; Review status: approved; Rationale: Task 01 records occurred_at for every osaka inclusion-state event as the UTC committer date of the ethereum/EIPs commit that edited EIPS/eip-7607.md (Hardfork Meta - Fusaka); that convention is stated in research/tasks/01-fork-eip-history/outputs/forks/osaka.yaml (unresolved_questions, 'Event dating convention'). The PFI-setting commit is ce71fb1cd0dfa18ab337860d3611a67110f5fc14 'Update EIP-7607: Proposing 7825 for Fusaka', verified in the read-only clone at the Task 01 run-wide pin a08f51fec5b2b5da457adb05b8cffb487fb4f7de - committer date 2025-02-21T09:11:23+08:00 = 2025-02-21T01:11:23Z (epoch 1740100283), author date 2025-02-21T02:11:23+01:00 (same instant), author Lukasz Rozmej. effective_at and recorded_at are therefore identical: under the EIP-7723 process PFI is set when the change adding the EIP to the Meta EIP's PFI section is merged, and this is a direct Meta EIP merge (squash commit of ethereum/EIPs#9392) rather than a meeting decision recorded later. No AllCoreDevs decision underlies this event and Task 01 identifies none: PFI is champion-initiated per EIP-7723, and Task 01 records decision_body as 'EIP champion via ethereum/EIPs pull request'. Exactly one event falls at or before the anchor - the creation commit 8096a3a1 (2024-12-02T17:16:34Z) - so it is the preceding candidate and the selected ref; the remaining six all fall after it (earliest 2025-06-29T00:27:36Z, +128.0 days). The EIP file was therefore byte-identical from creation until 2025-06-29, i.e. blob 47cbfed3 is exactly the content that stood in the repository at the moment PFI was set, which the pre-anchor blob comparison confirms (the diff of the following commit is against index 47cbfed3). date: Feb 21, 2025; Assessment marker: Proposal anchor; Date / time (UTC): 2025-02-21T10:10:59Z; Event: Proposed for Inclusion; Anchor kind: explicit_pfi; Selection mode: preceding; Offset from anchor: 0.00 days; Selected commit: ; Review status: approved; Rationale: Task 01's occurred_at for osaka-eip7883-e1 is the UTC committer date of the ethereum/EIPs commit that edited EIPS/eip-7607.md (Hardfork Meta - Fusaka), and that is the basis used here. Verified directly from the read-only clone at the Task 01 run-wide pin a08f51fec5b2b5da457adb05b8cffb487fb4f7de: `git log -1 --format='%H %cI %aI %s' c585cb4a35ef3bffb9cb42000be2b029ef65f6c0` returns committer 2025-02-21T10:10:59+00:00 (= 2025-02-21T10:10:59Z), author 2025-02-21T11:10:59+01:00, subject 'Update EIP-7607: ModExp Gas Cost Increase to Fusaka'. `git show <sha> -- EIPS/eip-7607.md` shows a single one-line addition, '* [EIP-7883](./eip-7883.md): ModExp Gas Cost Increase', inside the '### Proposed for Inclusion' section (the hunk at line 47 sits between the EIP-7805 and EIP-7825 bullets of that section, confirmed by reading EIPS/eip-7607.md at that commit); the string 'eip-7883' is absent from the file at the parent commit c585cb4a35ef...^. Under the EIP-7723 process PFI is champion-initiated, so no AllCoreDevs decision underlies this event: Task 01 records decision_body 'EIP champion via ethereum/EIPs pull request (PFI is champion-initiated per EIP-7723)', and the PR (ethereum/EIPs#9393) was opened by EIP author Marek Moraczynski, who is also the commit author. The AllCoreDevs decisions Task 01 does identify for this EIP belong to later states, not to PFI: ACDE#208 on 2025-03-27 for Considered for Inclusion (event osaka-eip7883-e2) and ACDT#36 on 2025-05-12 for Scheduled for Inclusion (event osaka-eip7883-e3). effective_at and recorded_at are identical because the proposal state took effect when the Meta EIP change merged. Context only: the Task 01 source registry records the GitHub merge timestamp of PR #9393 as 2025-02-21T10:11:00Z, one second after the squash commit's committer time; the committer time is used per the task contract.; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/c585cb4a35ef3bffb9cb42000be2b029ef65f6c0/EIPS/eip-7607.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/c585cb4a35ef3bffb9cb42000be2b029ef65f6c0/EIPS/eip-7607.md

date: Jun 03, 2025; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-06-03T20:23:57+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Largest single expansion of the EIP. Adds author Raul Kripalani (@raulk). Restructures the Specification into Definition / Blob schedule configuration / Execution layer configuration / Consensus layer configuration subsections. Execution layer: each blobSchedule fork is now linked to activation via a top-level `<fork_name>Time` Unix-timestamp field, BPO forks SHOULD be named `bpo<index>` starting at 1, activation timestamps are required only for post-Prague forks, and the illustrative JSON switches from raw-timestamp keys to named osaka/bpo1/bpo2 entries plus cancunTime/pragueTime/osakaTime/bpo1Time/bpo2Time. Adds the rule that a regular hardfork changing these parameters MUST do so by adding a blob schedule entry. Consensus layer: `BLOB_SCHEDULE` is defined as the sequence of blob-parameter changes after ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH, one entry per changing fork. Adds a modified `compute_fork_digest` taking `current_epoch` and `blob_schedule` and XOR-bitmasking `max_blobs_per_block` into the 4-byte digest (returning the base digest when no schedule entry applies). Adds a P2P Networking section: a new ENR entry `nfd` (SSZ Bytes4 ForkDigest, 'next fork digest') that nodes MUST evaluate alongside ENRForkID::next_* fields, a note that `Status` req/resp is unchanged but must carry the updated fork_digest, and a note that gossip topics rotate automatically at a BPO fork. Drops the earlier requirement 'BPO forks MUST NOT conflict with other fork schedules' and changes 'The timestamp in blobSchedule' to 'The slot number in the EL's blobSchedule'.; Classification rationale: Introduces new normative networking behaviour (fork-digest computation, ENR field, peer evaluation), a new activation-timestamp configuration mechanism, and removes one previously stated MUST NOT requirement.; Confidence: high; Commit: f37240a9aec671a46dd0e40b542eed02ddbe7d6a; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/f37240a9aec671a46dd0e40b542eed02ddbe7d6a; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/f37240a9aec671a46dd0e40b542eed02ddbe7d6a

date: Jun 11, 2025; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-06-12T01:08:03+08:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds a fourth managed parameter `maxBlobsPerTx` (maximum blobs per transaction) to the abstract, the managed-parameter list and the illustrative blobSchedule JSON (osaka 6, bpo1 12, bpo2 12), with the requirement that the field is optional, defaults to `max` when omitted, and is not used by the consensus layer. Adds a 'Transaction Pool considerations' subsection stating that transactions exceeding a post-BPO-fork blob count MUST NOT be propagated and should be considered for eviction. Also changes the illustrative osaka entry from target 9 / max 12 to target 6 / max 9.; Classification rationale: Adds a new configurable protocol parameter and a new MUST NOT propagation rule for the transaction pool.; Confidence: high; Commit: 79adba6a17513f273085dabeba988f495821653d; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/79adba6a17513f273085dabeba988f495821653d; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/79adba6a17513f273085dabeba988f495821653d

date: Jul 10, 2025; Assessment marker: Proposal anchor; Date / time (UTC): 2025-07-10T14:25:07Z; Event: EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion / Other EIPs; Anchor kind: normalized_proposal_equivalent; Selection mode: preceding; Offset from anchor: 0.00 days; Selected commit: ; Review status: approved; Rationale: effective_at and recorded_at are both the UTC committer date of ethereum/EIPs commit ec9133c32b174cfc315d2992f208a1d65cd45c92 ("Update EIP-7607: add EIP-7910 to fusaka scope as other EIP", merged by EIP-Bot), the commit that made the inclusion-state change to EIPS/eip-7607.md (Hardfork Meta - Fusaka). This matches Task 01's stated dating convention for this fork (outputs/forks/osaka.yaml, unresolved_questions: "occurred_at on every inclusion-state event is the UTC committer date of the ethereum/EIPs commit that changed EIPS/eip-7607.md"), and the contract's EIP-7723 rule that the inclusion state is set when the Meta EIP change is merged rather than when its pull request was opened. Verified directly from the pinned local clone: committer time 2025-07-10T22:25:07+08:00 == 2025-07-10T14:25:07Z; author time 2025-07-10T16:25:07+02:00 (Barnabas Busa). The underlying AllCoreDevs decision Task 01 identifies is All Core Devs - Testing (ACDT) #43, held 2025-07-07 (14:00 UTC per the pm-issue-1603 source note), at which - per the body of ethereum/EIPs PR #9990 quoted by Task 01 - "During ACDT on 7th of Jul 2025 we have agreed to have eth_config be part of the scope of fusaka". That decision therefore predates the repository record by about three days, but ethereum/pm at the run-wide pin contains no committed ACDT minutes, so no verifiable decision timestamp exists and the merge time is used. Task 01 records no local-offset value for this event (occurred_at was already UTC), so no offset preservation was needed here.; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/ec9133c32b174cfc315d2992f208a1d65cd45c92/EIPS/eip-7607.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/ec9133c32b174cfc315d2992f208a1d65cd45c92/EIPS/eip-7607.md

path.aria-label: date: Jul 09, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-07-10T01:40:29+08:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Extends the response object from four to nine members: adds `last` and `lastHash` (the last known configuration, equal to `next` when the next fork is also the last) and adds `currentForkId`, `nextForkId` and `lastForkId` carrying the EIP-6122 `FORK_HASH` value. Adds a 'Blob Parameter Only Forks' section stating that EIP-7892 BPO forks are interpreted as new forks that inherit the parent fork (recursively) and update only `blobsSchedule` values. Updates the abstract, the 'include every configuration parameter' MUST and the `activationTime` description to cover 'last'. Sample response gains the `last`/`lastHash`/`lastForkId` block and the hash values become `0x`-prefixed. Also fixes the EIP-2124 rationale link to the `.md` form.; Classification rationale: Adds three new response members and a new interpretation rule for BPO forks; both change what clients must return. Introduces this EIP's references to EIP-6122 and EIP-7892 (recorded as dependency events).; Confidence: high; Commit: 59c5b1739bc30ae056517d5c1bc1cfd6ebf0a30f; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/59c5b1739bc30ae056517d5c1bc1cfd6ebf0a30f; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/59c5b1739bc30ae056517d5c1bc1cfd6ebf0a30f

date: Jul 21, 2025; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-07-21T22:32:46+08:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Renames the agreed-upon precompile names `BN256_ADD`, `BN256_MUL`, `BN256_PAIRING` to `BN254_ADD`, `BN254_MUL`, `BN254_PAIRING` in the Cancun name list and in all four sample configurations. Also trims two trailing/duplicated spaces.; Classification rationale: The precompile names are part of the RPC response payload, so renaming them changes the bytes clients must return (and, at this revision, the CRC-32 configuration hash derived from them).; Confidence: high; Commit: 0ed437619eee7fd318709cfdae21965784ca939f; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/0ed437619eee7fd318709cfdae21965784ca939f; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/0ed437619eee7fd318709cfdae21965784ca939f

date: Jul 29, 2025; value: 5; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-07-29T21:26:20+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Largest redesign of the response. Removes the six hash/fork-id top-level members (`currentHash`/`nextHash`/`lastHash`, `currentForkId`/`nextForkId`/`lastForkId`) so the response contains exactly three members `current`, `next`, `last`, with `next`/`last` null when no future fork is configured. Deletes the 'Converting a Fork Configuration to a Hash' section (RFC-8785 canonicalization plus CRC-32) and replaces the 'CRC-32 as Hash Format' rationale with 'Why no configuration hash'. Adds a per-configuration `forkId` member (EIP-6122 FORK_HASH, `0x`-prefixed, zero-padded to four bytes, lower case). Renames the member `blobsSchedule` -> `blobSchedule` (including in the BPO section). Inverts the `precompiles` object so members are contract names and values are addresses, and requires members in alphabetical rather than 'canonical' order, with the rule that future forks' added members MUST be alphabetically sorted. Rewrites all sample configurations accordingly and adds a 'Without Future Fork Scheduled' example returning `next: null` and `last: null`. Weakens DDoS guidance from 'Clients SHOULD cache' to 'Clients MAY cache'.; Classification rationale: Removes response members and an entire hashing procedure, adds a new member, renames another and inverts the shape of the precompiles map; every one of these changes what a conforming client returns.; Confidence: high; Commit: 5fbf86102e60e49f6b8b5a26d94bbfbf6ecb638e; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5fbf86102e60e49f6b8b5a26d94bbfbf6ecb638e; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/5fbf86102e60e49f6b8b5a26d94bbfbf6ecb638e

date: May 09, 2025; Assessment marker: Proposal anchor; Date / time (UTC): 2025-05-09T21:56:48Z; Event: Considered for Inclusion; Anchor kind: fallback_cfi; Selection mode: preceding; Offset from anchor: 0.00 days; Selected commit: ; Review status: approved; Rationale: Task 01's occurred_at for event osaka-eip7934-e1 is the UTC committer date of the ethereum/EIPs commit that edited EIPS/eip-7607.md (the Fusaka Meta EIP), and that convention is stated run-wide in research/tasks/01-fork-eip-history/outputs/forks/osaka.yaml. Verified directly from the read-only clone at the Task 01 run-wide pin a08f51fec5b2b5da457adb05b8cffb487fb4f7de: 'git log -1' for commit 9d880b910da73181fd23758f1516c325ea26e3b9 reports committer date 2025-05-09T21:56:48+00:00 (author date 2025-05-09T14:56:48-07:00, subject "Update EIP-7607: Add ACDE#211 SFI & CFI'd EIPs", author Tim Beiko, merged by EIP-Bot). 'git show <sha> -- EIPS/eip-7607.md' shows exactly two added lines, one of which is "* [EIP-7934](./eip-7934.md): RLP Execution Block Size Limit"; rendering the file at that commit places that line under the "### Considered for Inclusion" heading, so this commit is the inclusion-state change that first placed EIP-7934 in a Fusaka inclusion state. The underlying AllCoreDevs decision Task 01 identifies is AllCoreDevs - Execution (ACDE) #211, held 2025-05-08 (ethereum/pm issue 1500, source pm-issue-1500), at which EIP-7934 was CFI'd and EIP-7935 was SFI'd; Task 01 records no minute-level timestamp for that call, so the exactly-timed repository record (2025-05-09T21:56:48Z) is used as both effective_at and recorded_at rather than a calendar-day-truncated meeting date. effective_at and recorded_at are therefore identical here; the ACDE#211 decision preceded the repository record by roughly 1.3 days.; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/9d880b910da73181fd23758f1516c325ea26e3b9/EIPS/eip-7607.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/9d880b910da73181fd23758f1516c325ea26e3b9/EIPS/eip-7607.md

path.aria-label: date: Jun 10, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-06-10T10:22:38+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Fixes the constant names in the Specification - the bullet list now introduces SAFETY_MARGIN instead of MARGIN, and the pseudocode computes MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE = MAX_BLOCK_SIZE - SAFETY_MARGIN instead of GOSSIP_UPPER_LIMIT - SAFETY_MARGIN, replacing an identifier the EIP never defined.; Classification rationale: Materially clarifies the normative validity formula - as written at creation the pseudocode derived the block-size bound from GOSSIP_UPPER_LIMIT, a constant that appears nowhere else in the document, so the specification was not self-contained. Marked substantive because it changes what an implementer reading the pseudocode literally must do; a reviewer could reasonably call it editorial because the intended numeric bound (10 MiB minus the margin) is unchanged, which is why confidence is medium rather than high.; Confidence: medium; Commit: 9076d228026a5ea6b9c7367c91d626c597d525a0; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/9076d228026a5ea6b9c7367c91d626c597d525a0; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/9076d228026a5ea6b9c7367c91d626c597d525a0

date: Jul 02, 2025; Assessment marker: Proposal anchor; Date / time (UTC): 2025-07-02T17:49:36Z; Event: EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion / Core EIPs; Anchor kind: other; Selection mode: preceding; Offset from anchor: 0.00 days; Selected commit: ; Review status: approved; Rationale: Task 01's occurred_at for event osaka-eip7939-e1 is the UTC committer date of the ethereum/EIPs commit that edited EIPS/eip-7607.md (the Fusaka Meta EIP); that convention is stated run-wide in research/tasks/01-fork-eip-history/outputs/forks/osaka.yaml ("Event dating convention: occurred_at on every inclusion-state event is the UTC committer date of the ethereum/EIPs commit that changed EIPS/eip-7607.md"). Verified directly from the read-only clone at the Task 01 run-wide pin a08f51fec5b2b5da457adb05b8cffb487fb4f7de: 'git log -1 --format=%H %cI %aI %s ca4fda0074fe0298f56abd0ffa7286de8d30531e' reports committer date 2025-07-02T17:49:36+00:00 (author date 2025-07-02T10:49:36-07:00, subject "Update EIP-7607: ACDE#214 changes", author Tim Beiko, "Merged by EIP-Bot"), and the commit is an ancestor of the pin. 'git show <sha> -- EIPS/eip-7607.md' shows the hunk adding "* [EIP-7939](./eip-7939.md): Count leading zeros (CLZ) opcode" (together with EIP-7907 and EIP-7934) and simultaneously deleting the whole "### Considered for Inclusion" section; rendering EIPS/eip-7607.md at that commit places the added EIP-7939 line under "### EIPs Scheduled for Inclusion" / "#### Core EIPs". The underlying AllCoreDevs decision Task 01 identifies is AllCoreDevs - Execution (ACDE) #214, held 2025-06-19 (scheduled 14:00 UTC per the agenda issue ethereum/pm 1569, source pm-issue-1569), the devnet-2 scope call at which EIP-7907, EIP-7934, EIP-7939 and EIP-7951 were SFI'd; the change was merged as ethereum/EIPs pull request 9957 (source eips-pr-9957, merged 2025-07-02T17:49:36Z, squash commit ca4fda0074fe). Task 01 records no minute-level timestamp for the call itself and notes that ethereum/pm at the run-wide pin ecf2eecc74adc479cea38b3d3b9a670c320421b1 holds no committed minutes for ACDE >= 205, so the exactly-timed repository record is used as both effective_at and recorded_at rather than a calendar-day-truncated meeting date; ACDE#214 preceded the repository record by roughly 13.2 days, the largest such gap in the Fusaka Task 01 record. Task 01 lists exactly two inclusion-state events for this fork-EIP pair - osaka-eip7939-e1 (this one) and osaka-eip7939-e2, the 2026-02-04T22:29:12Z move of EIP-7607 to Final that retitled the section to "Included EIPs" - so there is a single inclusion cycle with no removal and re-proposal, and alternative_event_ids is empty by observation.; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/ca4fda0074fe0298f56abd0ffa7286de8d30531e/EIPS/eip-7607.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/ca4fda0074fe0298f56abd0ffa7286de8d30531e/EIPS/eip-7607.md

date: May 12, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-05-13T07:56:41+08:00; Change type: security_assumption; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Replaces the 'TBA' Security Considerations placeholder with a substantive claim (CLZ is a stateless opcode with a low worst-case constant cost in memory, compute and proving, and is therefore not exploitable for denial of service). Also adds three co-authors (Georgios Konstantopoulos, Jochem Brouwer, Ben Adams), adds an SP1/ZK proving-cost paragraph to the Motivation, adds a C++ reference implementation including an SP1 rv32im-optimised 8-limb variant, and expands the gas-cost rationale with SP1 proving comparisons against ADD.; Classification rationale: Fills in the EIP's security assumptions, which had been an explicit placeholder, and adds reference implementations that implementers and reviewers may rely on. The opcode semantics and the gas cost (3 at this point) are unchanged, so the substantive label rests on the security-assumption and reference-implementation content; confidence medium because the remainder of the diff is motivation, rationale and author metadata.; Confidence: medium; Commit: 8008342ee834baf5d9a93b22aeb1fcae43694c7e; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/8008342ee834baf5d9a93b22aeb1fcae43694c7e; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/8008342ee834baf5d9a93b22aeb1fcae43694c7e

date: Jun 09, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-06-09T10:17:58+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Adds a fifth author (Giulio Rebuffo); turns the ZK-proving motivation paragraph into a three-item list (cheaper compute, cheaper ZK proving, smaller bytecode); renames the rationale section 'Opcode namespace conservation' to 'Preference over CTZ (count trailing zeros)' and adds the observation that CLZ cannot be implemented in terms of CTZ; and capitalises clz/add to CLZ/ADD throughout the prose.; Classification rationale: Motivation, rationale and author-metadata prose only. The opcode, its semantics, its encoding and its gas cost are untouched; the added CTZ argument justifies the existing design rather than changing it.; Confidence: high; Commit: c43098e67b8fd94c5166bd7a46ec53cafac04123; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/c43098e67b8fd94c5166bd7a46ec53cafac04123; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/c43098e67b8fd94c5166bd7a46ec53cafac04123

path.aria-label: date: Jul 04, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-07-04T17:19:01+08:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Doubles the P256VERIFY gas cost from 3450 to 6900 in both the Precompile section and the Gas Schedule, replacing the '15% more expensive than secp256k1' justification with a statement that benchmarking found R1 verification significantly slower than ECRECOVER. date: Sep 27, 2024; Inclusion state: CFI (RIP); Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2024-09-27T18:42:32Z; Historical label: Considered for Inclusion (listed as 'RIP-7212: Precompile for secp256r1 Curve Support'); Normalization rationale: Commit 1d4ce546 (PR #8911, formalizing the ACDE#197 Pectra scope split, 2024-09-26, pm issue #1153) listed the secp256r1 precompile under 'Considered for Inclusion' as RIP-7212 - the Rollup Improvement Proposal that EIP-7951 later superseded. EIP-7951 (created 2025-05-27) specifies the same precompile with security fixes while 'maintaining full interface compatibility' with RIP-7212 (per its abstract), and ACDE#214's update replaced the RIP-7212 CFI entry with the EIP-7951 SFI entry in the same commit. The event is recorded on this relationship as the same proposal thread, with the identifier difference preserved in raw_label.; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/1d4ce5462677c5af8852cae6105ebf4c941f363b/EIPS/eip-7607.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/1d4ce5462677c5af8852cae6105ebf4c941f363b/EIPS/eip-7607.md

path.aria-label: date: Jul 01, 2025; Assessment marker: Selected assessment ref; Date / time (UTC): 2025-07-01T20:21:20Z; Event: Selected ref · d386b29b5a31; Anchor kind: normalized_proposal_equivalent; Selection mode: preceding; Offset from anchor: -0.89 days; Selected commit: d386b29b5a31bd5cfd8d21bbf4e8a0c87734085e; Review status: approved; Rationale: Default preceding rule applied. The complete Task 01 revision_history.events list for EIP-7951 has five events (creation eip7951-e00 plus revisions eip7951-e01..e04); all five commits touching EIPS/eip-7951.md were re-listed from the pinned clone with 'git log --follow' and each committer instant re-derived in UTC, matching Task 01 exactly: 2025-07-01T20:21:20Z, 2025-07-04T09:19:01Z, 2025-09-24T21:46:32Z, 2025-09-30T23:59:10Z and 2026-01-21T09:16:44Z. Exactly one falls at or before the anchor 2025-07-02T17:49:36Z - the creation commit d386b29b5a31, 77,296 seconds (0.89 days) earlier - so it is the preceding candidate and, by default, the selection. The following candidate 75a5ba895711 is 142,165 seconds (1.65 days) after the anchor and therefore inside the seven-day eligibility ceiling, but the exception test fails on its merits (see post_anchor_exception): it is a normative gas-cost change explicitly driven by implementation benchmarking, i.e. exactly the later client-implementation feedback the contract excludes, and the contract states that seven days is a ceiling rather than a nearest-commit rule. The selected content is therefore the EIP exactly as it stood when the ACDE#214 inclusion decision was recorded in the Meta EIP: P256VERIFY at address 0x100 for 3450 gas, claiming the exact same interface and gas cost as RIP-7212, status Draft. Resolution verified at the pin: 'git ls-tree d386b29b5a31bd5cfd8d21bbf4e8a0c87734085e -- EIPS/eip-7951.md' confirms the path existed at that commit and yields blob f4600e688beaeaf11fa6292ea3477e9ca3febe56 (mode 100644); 'git cat-file blob' piped to sha256sum yields 4fca0c5daef344b79ec1d19297ecf6a36f41bf31e02a29038a05701948aeebed over 12,408 bytes / 281 lines. information_cutoff_at is the verified anchor time because the preceding revision was selected.; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/d386b29b5a31bd5cfd8d21bbf4e8a0c87734085e/EIPS/eip-7951.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/d386b29b5a31bd5cfd8d21bbf4e8a0c87734085e/EIPS/eip-7951.md

Subtitle text 'Primary line: cumulative substantive post-creation revisions. Faint line: all post-creation revisions. Filled inclusion markers are state transitions; open gray markers preserve same-state records. Triangles at panel bottoms are relevant devnets; lower opacity denotes medium-confidence participation. Assessment review lanes from top to bottom: REF, PFI, CFI, SFI, then devnet/testnet markers. Each event type has a fixed lane; the proposal anchor is the amber dashed rule. CUTOFF is the fork-level initial-evaluation horizon; its tooltip identifies whether the EIP is forecastable or late scope.'
